prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: IT Services (managed hosting), Company Size: 55 employees, Pain Points: Change management causing outages, incident response time SLA breaches, no capacity planning process, customer satisfaction declining, knowledge transfer gaps when staff leave

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Low","gaps":"Lack of formal change management process, inadequate incident response procedures, no capacity planning, declining customer satisfaction metrics, insufficient knowledge management","recommendations":"Implement a formal change management process (ISO 20000), establish incident response procedures with clear SLAs (ISO/IEC 27001), develop a capacity planning process (ISO/IEC 20000), improve customer satisfaction tracking and feedback mechanisms, enhance knowledge management and documentation practices","standards":"ISO/IEC 20000 (IT Service Management), ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management), ISO 9001 (Quality Management)"}
